liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (5 reviews): Second set has a long Eyes of the World leading into Estimated Prophet and Franklin's Tower; Eyes of the World runs over twenty minutes [6][8][9][13][14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): China Cat into I Know You Rider opens the first set; The transition from China Cat into I Know You Rider is called uplifting and sweet [6][11][12]
- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): The Franklin's Tower in the second set is described as hypnotic, with Jerry taking the listener somewhere special; Eyes and Franklin's Tower are both called great [6][16]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jerry in a haze on Stagger Lee and Peggy-O, and compares them with 1980s versions such as 6-14-85 Greek [12]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea into Easy To Love You as second set opener is a favorite of this reviewer [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-11-05.senn-barnehama.minches.83710.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 190 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd79-11-05.sbd.wier.12177.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 4.11/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound lovely; Reviewer thinks the audience recording sounds better and more realistic than the soundboard [7][14]
- **gd1979-11-05.sbd.clugston.2410.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience patches cover the start of Stagger Lee, part of Estimated Prophet, and Lost Sailor from 4:50 to the end [3]
- **gd1979-11-05.nak300.sharpless.89053.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 3.94/5 by 18 [4]

## Around the show

- First set is good, but the second set is judged spectacular [8]
- Reviewer calls it filler on the tour, ranking Cape Cod, Landover and New Haven as the tour's best [9]
- Reviewer rates the portion before Drums highly and everything else only average [13]
- Reviewer rarely sees China into Rider open a first set, and finds Easy To Love You as a second set opener surprising [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-11-05.senn-barnehama.minches.83710.flac16**: taped by Joel Barnehama; transferred by David Minches; source: Master Audience Cassette; 2 Sennheiser 421s + Sennheiser 441> Nakamichi 550 [1]
- **gd79-11-05.sbd.wier.12177.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: An audience recording exists: three Nakamichi 300 mics into a Nakamichi 550 deck, from row eleven, center; Master soundboard cassette to cassette to DAT to CDR, pitch corrected, mastered by Scott Clugston; Audience patches from a Nakamichi CM300 recording were added to the soundboard [2][13]
- **gd1979-11-05.sbd.clugston.2410.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR [3]. Also: Original transcription ran about 4.5% slow; this version is speed-corrected; Audience source: Nakamichi CM300 mics into a Nakamichi 550 deck, two cassette generations, DAT, then CDR [3]
- **gd1979-11-05.nak300.sharpless.89053.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by David Minches; source: Unknown Taper; Recorded with 3 Nak 300s> Nak 550 2nd Generation Audience Cassette provided by Gordon Sharpless [4]
